threshold_ge2_strong_emergence.description: Primary: >=2 KSI events in the 3-year label window. Two independent severe events at a previously clean site indicates a systematic hazard.
threshold_ge2_strong_emergence.city_approach_note: Definitional zero: all candidates had no prior KSI history and cannot trigger the city annual >=5-crash threshold

full_ranking_recall_at_k.note: Full-population recall across all 81,007 candidates. Source: compute_verified_numbers.py -> model_scores.parquet

threshold_ge2_strong_emergence.test_split_artifact_note: Milestone reports showed recall@500=1.000 on the random split. This was a test-set artifact: the 80/20 split placed only 2 of 22 emergent sites in the test fold; finding both gave 2/2=100%. Full-population figures above are the operationally correct metric.

threshold_ge1_any_ksi.description: Secondary: >=1 KSI event in the 3-year label window. Any single severe crash at a previously clean site. Broader catch, larger harm pool.
threshold_ge1_any_ksi.note_on_event_composition: 22 sites with >=2 KSI contribute 44 events; 367 sites with exactly 1 KSI contribute 367 events. Total 411.

full_ranking_recall_at_k.note: Full-population recall across all 81,007 candidates. Source: compute_verified_numbers.py -> model_scores.parquet

harm_at_top500_caught_sites.note: 89 caught sites include 13 of the 22 >=2 sites (26 events) + 76 exactly-1-KSI sites (76 events) = 102 events

threshold_ge1_any_ksi.interpretation: Weaker recall% than >=2 threshold (23% vs 59% at top-500) but stronger economic case due to larger harm pool. Both thresholds confirm the city-comparison result: city approach identifies 0%, model identifies >0%.

ablation_protocol_a.note: Ablation run on M4 pipeline instance. Hyperparameters frozen from crash-only model. Four feature sets evaluated with identical params.
ablation_protocol_a.crash_only_spearman_vs_headline_discrepa: Ablation crash-only Spearman (0.155) is slightly lower than the headline verified-run figure (0.175). The ablation used the M4 pipeline run; 0.175 is from milestone3a_results.json. Both confirm the same result: infrastructure features reduce rather than improve rank signal.
ablation_protocol_a.sufficiency_null: CONFIRMED -- all three infrastructure feature groups reduced Spearman rank correlation vs crash-only under frozen hyperparameters at 76.2m intersection resolution.
